what: Hindu fair in February at Maldiad honouring Baba Bodh Nath Jogi, c. 5,000 attend; its Jogis said to be connected with Tilla (Jhelum)
quote: A Hindu fair is also held in Maldiad in honor of Baba Bodh Nath Jogi in February, attended by some 5.000 persons. These Jogis are connected with those of Koh Tilla ill Jhelum district.

what: Statement of absence: apart from Sikh spiritual head Baba Khem Singh of Kallar, no religious sects needing notice; no Gosain/Sannyasi/Bairagi/Udasi sect mentioned anywhere in the volume
quote: the spiritual head of the Potho- war Sikhs, Baba Khem Singh, has his head-quarters at Kallar in the Kahuta tahsil, where he has built himself a palace. There are no other religious sects requiring special notice.
